blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, ILOCOS SUR, Philippines — Environmental advocates, youth groups, cyclists and residents affected by mining and dredging operations gathered in Santa, Ilocos Sur on Saturday (Nov. 21) for a bicycle ride and fluvial parade along the Abra River, renewing calls to stop large-scale extractive activities from the province’s mountains to its coast. Led by the environmental group Defend Ilocos Sur, the activity sought to highlight the alleged environmental damage and livelihood losses caused by the ongoing dredging operation and mining activities in the province.
